title: Variability Aware Recursive Neural Network (VARNN): A Residual-Memory Model for Capturing Temporal Deviation in Sequence Regression Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2510.08944v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Real-world time-series regression often involves non-stationarity, heteroscedasticity, and regime changes, under which recent prediction errors may contain structured information about local temporal mismatch between model predictions and observations. Learning how to represent and reuse these errors can therefore provide useful information for subsequent prediction. We introduce the Variability-Aware Recursive Neural Network (VARNN), a residual-aware architecture for supervised time-series regression that learns an explicit residual-memory state from recent prediction errors and uses it to condition subsequent predictions. Specifically, VARNN maps scalar prediction innovations into a learned nonlinear, vector-valued residual representation over a short context. Across nine datasets spanning energy, healthcare, and environmental domains, VARNN achieves lower test MSE than the compared static, lag-based, and sequence-model baselines.

translated_title: 变异性感知递归神经网络（VARNN）：一种用于捕获序列回归建模中时间偏差的残差记忆模型
translated_abstract: 现实世界的时间序列回归通常涉及非平稳性、异方差性和状态变化，在这种情况下，近期的预测误差可能包含关于模型预测与观测之间局部时间失配的结构化信息。因此，学习如何表示和复用这些误差可以为后续预测提供有用的信息。我们提出了变异性感知递归神经网络（VARNN），这是一种面向监督时间序列回归的残差感知架构，它从近期的预测误差中学习显式的残差记忆状态，并利用该状态来调节后续的预测。具体而言，VARNN将标量预测新息映射为在短上下文范围内学习到的非线性向量值残差表示。在涵盖能源、医疗健康和环境领域的九个数据集上，VARNN取得了比所对比的静态模型、基于滞后特征的模型和序列模型基线更低的测试MSE。
tldr: 本文提出变异性感知递归神经网络（VARNN），通过从近期预测误差中学习显式的残差记忆状态来调节后续预测，在能源、医疗和环境领域的九个数据集上取得了优于静态模型、滞后特征模型和序列模型基线的回归精度。
